verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing says it can 'automatically block out-of-policy purchases, with preset rules and limits' and offers 'auto-enforced controls' on spend limits. Its Budgets API manages Spend Limits, and its global cards ship with 'built-in controls', which covers amount-based restriction and point-of-sale blocking. However, nothing in the evidence documents restricting cards by merchant category or by specific merchant, and all support is vendor marketing. Missing for 10: documented merchant-category and merchant-level card restrictions, explicit point-of-sale decline or auto-lock behavior detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
